test_title: PYST 21 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 20 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error.**

A. The company has been B. experiencing a lot of C. problems since D. the last two years.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. **problems since**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"the last two years"** is incorrect in the given context because it is preceded by the word **"since"**, which requires a specific point in time (e.g., "since 2021") rather than a duration.
 
• The correct word to use with a duration like "the last two years" would be **"for"**.
 
• The corrected sentence should be: *The company has been experiencing a lot of problems **for** the last two years.*

Correct sentence: *The company has been experiencing a lot of problems **for** the last two years*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of "since":**

 
 
• **Since** is used to refer to a specific point in time in the past (e.g., since 2020).
 
• **Example:** I have been working here **since** 2015.
 
 
 
• **Usage of "for":**
 
 
• **For** is used to refer to a duration of time (e.g., for two years).
 
• **Example:** I have been working here **for** two years.
